title: styleTokenGroups
responsibility: Groups the app style tokens by their declared prefixes, assigns them to documented roles and says how each token is drawn.

inputs.name: groupFor.name
inputs.description: A custom property name such as --hx-color-primary.

inputs.name: groupTokens.list
inputs.description: The discovered tokens, each with its group.

inputs.name: assignRoles.group
inputs.description: A token group whose tokens are shown by role.

outputs.name: unclassified
outputs.description: The name of the last group, for tokens no declared prefix claims.

outputs.name: roles
outputs.description: The documented roles of each group, from the shared app style tokens config.

outputs.name: drawings
outputs.description: The ordered rules that say how a token is drawn: the first matching prefix, its specimen kind and its style template.

outputs.name: groupFor
outputs.description: The first declared group whose prefix claims the name, else the unclassified group.

outputs.name: groupTokens
outputs.description: Every declared group with its tokens, plus the unclassified group when it has any.

outputs.name: assignRoles
outputs.description: Each token once under the first role that names it; tokens no role names are listed under the unassigned card.

outputs.name: sample
outputs.description: Two lines of numerals for leading and numeral tokens, otherwise Aa Bb 0123.

outputs.name: headingId
outputs.description: The text in lower case with each run of non-word characters as a hyphen, after the prefix styles-group-.
